notes: Rule 3: genuine live catalogue, not a scam/liquidation domain -- Impressum confirms moemax Deutschland GmbH, Firmensitz Mergentheimerstrasse 59, 97084 Wuerzburg, Amtsgericht Wuerzburg HRB 11841 (distinct legal entity/registration number from XXXLutz DE's HRA 6804/HRB 8556 at S.N.115/c115.json, though both are headquartered in Wuerzburg as sister brands under the Lutz group). robots.txt has no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web specific disallow (checked via curl_cffi impersonation after the default fetch was blocked). Access route: www.moemax.de sits behind a Cloudflare managed JS challenge that blocked plain requests, WebFetch, r.jina.ai and translate.goog identically (all returned the 'Just a moment...' interstitial, since the origin issues the challenge to any non-browser-fingerprint client including proxied fetchers) -- resolved via curl_cffi browser impersonation, sweeping the profile list; chrome124/131/133a/136/145/146, safari180/184/260 and firefox133/135/144/147 all passed while chrome99-123, chrome131_android, safari17_0/18_0 and edge101 were still challenged, confirming the winning profile is per-request/per-fingerprint rather than universal, so profiles were rotated across the batch fetch. Once past the challenge, category pages are the same SAP-Commerce-family platform as XXXLutz DE (identical asset host 'assets.moemax.com', identical SmartEdit-ticket injector referencing assets.xxxlutz.com, identical sitemap-categories.xml with the same 'C<id>C<id>...' breadcrumb-coded slugs) and embed an SSR JSON pagination block ('pageSize'/'totalPages'/'totalResults') plus a matching 'resultCountContainer data-track-value' in the rendered HTML. Category tree built from sitemap-categories.xml (3048 URLs after stripping duplicate loc blocks; query-string facet variants such as ?p_color=/?pa_material=/?ec_brand=/?pa_special_features= stripped out as non-canonical facet re-cuts of the same population, not separate categories). qty = SSR totalResults; verified per leaf via the exhaustion check ceil(totalResults/pageSize)==totalPages -- pageSize=60 stable across all 89 leaf fetches, all 89 passed with no mismatch. Rule 0 applied in full: Lighting > Lighting by Room fully expanded (Wohnzimmer/Schlafzimmer/Kueche/Esszimmer/Badezimmer/Flur/Buero/Kinderzimmer -- bathroom and office/hallway lighting kept in scope purely on product-type grounds); all mirror types kept including bathroom, cosmetic/makeup and LED/backlit mirrors; outdoor lighting (solar, path, string lights, motion-sensor outdoor lights, LED outdoor) kept in scope; LED-Leuchten (LED Lighting) is the site's own product-type tree covering the same ceiling/floor/wall/pendant fixture types already listed by form-factor and by room -- emitted as its own parent branch per Rule 0.6 (genuine second nav branch, not a facet), overlap documented here rather than dropped. 'Gartendeko' (Outdoor Decor, 436) is a room/application-based node under the Garden section that on inspection (product titles) contains largely the same product types already captured under Home Accessories (Laternen/lanterns, Windlichter/wind-lanterns, Uebertoepfe/planters) plus some outdoor rugs (textile, out of scope at the SKU level but not separable from this URL's own count) -- kept per Rule 0.5/0.6 as outdoor lanterns and planters are explicitly in-scope product types and this is a genuine separate nav branch (Garden > Garden Decor) rather than a duplicate URL of the Home-Accessories listing. Excluded per rules: Leuchtmittel/Gluehbirnen/LED-Leuchtmittel (light bulbs, C33C12 and children); Duftkerzen (scented candles) and 'Duefte & Diffuser' (home fragrance, C37C6) -- kept only unscented Stabkerzen/Stumpenkerzen and Kerzenstaender/-halter; Kunstpflanzen (artificial plants, C37C3C1); the entire Weihnachten/Christmas tree (C43 and all children -- Weihnachtsdeko, Weihnachtsbeleuchtung, Weihnachtsbaumschmuck, Weihnachtsfiguren, Weihnachtsbaeume, Weihnachtstextilien); all bathroom furniture/fixtures/hardware under Badzubehoer (C44 -- Handtuchhalter, Seifenschalen/-spender, Waeschekoerbe, WC-Buersten -- none are mirrors or lighting so all excluded per Rule 0.4); all furniture (C30, C45 garden furniture, C46 kids furniture), rugs/textiles (C31 cushions/bedding, C32 rugs), fitted kitchens and kitchen/laundry appliances (C34, C42, C47), general storage (C36), coat-rack/hallway furniture (C38), leisure/toys/travel (C41); within Kochen & Essen (C35) excluded all cookware, knives/cutlery, kitchen helpers/gadgets, spice mills, oil/vinegar dispensers, napkins, bar/wine tools, coffee/tea accessories, thermos flasks, storage jars/tins and baking accessories (all functional kitchen items), keeping only Glaeser (glassware -- all types per rule), Geschirr (dinnerware: plates/sets/bowls/cups), and the decorative slice of Tischkultur (serving platters, coasters, glass bottles/carafes). Ashtrays (Aschenbecher) and drinking straws (Strohhalme) excluded as neither glassware-proper nor a listed decorative-accessory type. Akustikpaneele (Acoustic Panels, 684) verified via product titles (e.g. 'Akustikpaneel Lucia Eichefarben') as genuine decorative wood-veneer wall panels, not construction/soundproofing hardware -- kept under Wall Decor.
